ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester: useEffect(() => end.current?.scrollIntoView(...)) implicitly returned the scrollIntoView value as cleanup; newer Chromium returns a Promise from scroll APIs, so React called it as destroy() -> runtime crash of whole page on opening chat. Wrapped body in braces. Same pattern fixed in Leads.jsx Cell useEffect.

rca of the issue: Chat crash: arrow-function useEffect implicitly returned scrollIntoView() result; Chromium now returns a Promise -> React treats non-function return as cleanup and throws 'destroy is not a function' on next effect run. Repro: open portal, click chat-open-btn. Mitigation: use block body in effects.
